ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached graph is a table with three genotype columns labeled AA, Aa, and aa. The frequency shown under AA is 36%, the frequency shown under Aa is 45%, and the frequency under aa is shown as ?%. Reasoning: The recessive homozygote genotype is aa. Since genotype frequencies for the trait must sum to 100%, the missing aa frequency is 100% - 36% - 45% = 19%.
